description: This file contains unit tests for the plugin loader, registry resolution, and memory plugin management in the openclaw project, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Hook that runs after each test case to reset plugin loader test state.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for a specific functionality or component.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function to verify test conditions.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case within a test suite.

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets the current active plugin registry and cache key.

methods.name: createEmptyPluginRegistry
methods.description: Creates a new empty plugin registry instance.

methods.name: resolveRuntimePluginRegistry
methods.description: Resolves and returns the plugin registry based on the load options or current active one.

methods.name: clearPluginLoaderCache
methods.description: Clears cached plugin loader data, including memory plugin registries.

methods.name: resetPluginLoaderTestStateForTest
methods.description: Resets the plugin loader test state before each test.

methods.name: getMemoryEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a memory embedding provider by its ID.

methods.name: registerMemoryEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Registers a new memory embedding provider.

methods.name: buildMemoryPromptSection
methods.description: Builds a memory prompt section based on available tools.

methods.name: getMemoryRuntime
methods.description: Retrieves the current memory runtime configuration.

methods.name: registerMemoryFlushPlanResolver
methods.description: Registers a resolver for memory flush plans.

methods.name: registerMemoryPromptSection
methods.description: Registers a memory prompt section function.

methods.name: resolveMemoryFlushPlan
methods.description: Resolves a memory flush plan based on current context.
